schedules.title: Daily Compiler Primary
schedules.prompt: Operate only the Daily AI Brief Compiler in gttome/Daily-AI-Brief-Compiler. Do not access or modify gttome/Daily-AI-Brief. Resolve the target edition as the next America/Chicago calendar day. Read protected-main contracts first. Reuse an existing shadow/YYYY-MM-DD execution if present; otherwise allocate exactly one. EDITION IMAGE STRATEGY IS IMMUTABLE: when allocating a new execution, bind images.strategy exactly once from the then-current D1 activation state and persist images.strategy_bound_at plus images.strategy_contract_version. If D1 is proof_required at allocation, bind proposal1r_legacy for that entire edition. If D1 is active with a valid digest-bound activation receipt at allocation, bind d1_work_browser_fresh_chat with daily-compiler-image-contract-v5. When resuming an existing execution, use only its persisted images.strategy; later global D1 activation/deactivation must never switch that edition mid-run. Before editorial research read config/resource-registry.json and config/future-brief-inbox.json. Preserve valid persisted work and emit compact run/resource observations. If the bound strategy is proposal1r_legacy, use the pre-activation Proposal 1R reader-image path and preserve accepted-image immutability. If the bound strategy is d1_work_browser_fresh_chat, seal six story image specifications and six unique composition assignments, set image phase SPEC_READY, persist state, and stop image generation in this semantic schedule; the separate D1 Work Cloud Browser image lane owns six fresh regular ordinary ChatGPT story chats and exact Git ingest. If a later invocation observes GITHUB_VERIFIED for the bound D1 strategy, reuse the exact accepted assets and continue BUNDLE. Never use Codex, paid APIs, TinyFish/other metered external browser services, owner file transfer, local computer, Supervisor, Watchdog Ring, leases, persistent workers, wake PRs, continuous AI polling, or runtime software repair.

schedules.title: Daily Compiler Recovery 1
schedules.prompt: Operate only on gttome/Daily-AI-Brief-Compiler. Do not access or modify gttome/Daily-AI-Brief. Find the newest nonterminal Compiler shadow edition; if none exists, exit without edition mutation. Read compiler-state.json first and preserve the same execution and every completed output. Never reopen completed editorial/content work or regenerate an accepted image. IMAGE STRATEGY IS EDITION-BOUND AND IMMUTABLE: use only the persisted images.strategy, images.strategy_bound_at and images.strategy_contract_version from this execution. Never switch an existing edition merely because protected-main D1 activation changed after allocation. If the bound strategy is proposal1r_legacy, continue Proposal 1R. If the bound strategy is d1_work_browser_fresh_chat and phase is SPEC_READY, BROWSER_RUNNING, PACKAGE_ACCEPTED, or GIT_INGEST, do not compete with the Work Cloud Browser image lane; preserve state and exit the image boundary. If the bound D1 phase is GITHUB_VERIFIED, reuse the exact six accepted images and continue toward BUNDLE_READY. Record the smallest exact blocker if an external capability is unavailable. Never use Codex, paid APIs, TinyFish/other metered services, owner transfer, local computer, Supervisor, Watchdog Ring, leases, persistent workers, wake PRs, continuous polling, or runtime software repair.
